A '''Rancor''' lived on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] and used the [[rancor forest]] as their hunting grounds. During the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] defeated this Rancor and tamed their child, [[Fogg]].
